Method of Attack: Downloads and executes Bart ransomware after being executed from a JavaScript file
Attack Vector: SPAM emails with ZIP attachments containing obfuscated JavaScript files executed by Windows Script Host (wscript.exe)
Indicators of Compromise: ZIP attachments named Photos.zip, Photo.zip, image.zip, picture.zip
JavaScript files named PDF_[10_digits].js, FILE-[10_digits].js, doc-[10_digits].js (e.g., doc-470655521.js)
Execution of wscript.exe running the JavaScript
